fields.statement: At 8cb18c39, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestWatchdog -v passed: TestWatchdogTransient shows the go $WORK, git index.lock and GitHub 502 failures each resumed once with --retry, a non-matching failure (FAIL: TestThing) and an attended run left to the owner, and a live run with a 503 output left alone; a second poll inside the budget of 1 resumes nothing.
